audit_note: Official aims, review policy and acceptance/rejection table read. Regional location and missing JIF were not used to assign difficulty. name: Central European Economic Journal

scope_notes: Theoretical and empirical economics/finance and interdisciplinary research; explicit areas include policy evaluation, econometrics, machine learning, population and household well-being. Central/Eastern Europe is emphasized; other-country work needs an international contribution. Systematic or critical reviews are accepted; opinion papers are confined to special issues.

route.conditions: Current journal-specific instructions exclude submission and article-processing fees, without a waiver, institutional affiliation or paid membership condition. English manuscripts normally must not exceed 40 A4 pages. From November 2026, manuscript declarations must state whether and how generative AI was used; AI tools cannot be authors and humans retain responsibility.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None identified in the current four-page author instructions; no mandatory membership, conference registration or priced overlength option is listed.

fee_evidence.note: Official instructions explicitly exclude submission and article-processing fees, specify the 40-page norm, and introduce generative-AI declarations for articles published from November 2026.

difficulty.basis: No comparative difficulty band established. Official scope requires original theoretical/empirical research or reviews that advance the field, with findings relevant beyond a single country and clear international-literature contributions where applicable. These are substantive fit requirements but do not disclose a comparative selectivity level; Central/Eastern European relevance does not imply easy acceptance.

ai_policy.summary: From November 2026, manuscripts must declare whether and how generative AI was used, name tools and purposes, and retain human authorship and responsibility.

audit_note: Official scope, four-page instructions and metrics tab read. Platform lists CiteScore 1.4, SJR 0.209, SNIP 0.439 and h5 measures without a stated metric year/window; all were omitted from the year-qualified metrics array. No acceptance figure located in the inspected policies. Independent review read all four author-instruction pages and official scope: no submission/processing fees, double-blind review, original and systematic/critical-review formats, 40-page limit and manuscript AI declarations for articles published from November 2026 are supported. The displayed citation values lack metric years and remain excluded. Sources: https://reference-global.com/download/document/journal/CEEJ/Submission_and_Formatting_Instructions.pdf ; https://reference-global.com/journal/CEEJ .

name: Economía (PUCP)
publisher: Department of Economics, Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú
scope_notes: Original theoretical and empirical research across economics, with an emphasis on Latin America and an international author community. Existing-data economic studies and economically substantive methods can fit. Research-data guidance encourages sharing supporting data, software, code and models; this is not a standalone data/software journal.

route.conditions: Official About policy broadly excludes fees to authors and readers and says institutional resources fully support publication; no selective waiver or author affiliation/membership condition is attached. Full author-guideline retrieval remained restricted. The full official AI policy was retrieved: supportive AI use must be disclosed, authorship and responsibility remain human, and AI-generated/manipulated images are prohibited.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None under the official blanket no-author-fees policy; no membership or registration condition is attached to that policy.

fee_evidence.note: Official Revenue section broadly excludes fees to authors/readers and states publication is fully institutionally supported.
Direct full author-guideline retrieval was restricted; no unobserved length or preparation condition is asserted.
Full official policy permits disclosed supportive AI use, retains human authorship/responsibility, and prohibits AI-generated or manipulated images.

difficulty.basis: No comparative difficulty band established. Official search-indexed policies describe originality/relevance screening and double-blind external review, but a current year-defined selectivity statistic was not verified. Latin American emphasis and open access supply no basis to infer easy acceptance.

ai_policy.summary: Official indexed excerpt permits supportive AI assistance with disclosure and human responsibility but excludes AI-generated or manipulated images. Full page was bot-blocked during this pass.

audit_note: Direct About/author/evaluation-page retrieval remained restricted, and ordinary HTTP retrieval returned a challenge page. Official search-indexed policy text was available but is weaker than direct page evidence; no unverified metric was imported. A 2024 accepted-to-publication timing claim in an official call is neither review duration nor acceptance probability and was not used for ranking. Independent review directly retrieved the evaluation policy, confirming at least two external double-blind reviewers. About, OA, author and AI direct fetches were restricted; official indexed policy text corroborates blanket no-author fees and the AI-image prohibition/disclosure requirement. Earlier fee-role direct observations are retained; this review does not claim independent direct access to those fee/AI pages. name: Applied Psychological Measurement
scope_notes: Applied psychometric methods, measurement comparisons and methodological evidence synthesis. Simulations must give practical measurement guidance; purely statistical papers without an applied measurement problem do not fit. The computer-program exchange is a short software-abstract format, not a general software journal. Sage requires disclosure of generative AI and prohibits specified uses, including producing a submission through successive prompts and analysing experiences/themes; ordinary assistive editing has a disclosure exemption. Source: https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy. Software here includes the two-page Computer Program Exchange abstract and short Software Notes; commercial Software Reviews are invited. Brief reports are about 1000 words including all elements.

route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for standard publication within article limits. No compulsory membership, registration, or page/overlength payment is specified in the inspected journal instructions. Optional paid services and third-party reuse permissions are separate.

fee_evidence.note: Independently checked the journal-specific fee section: submission and publication incur no fee; paid Sage Choice is optional. Author instructions state no compulsory membership or registration payment.

name: Social Studies of Science
scope_notes: Science and Technology Studies rather than a general methods journal. Social or institutional analyses of research practices, collaboration and knowledge production may fit when they make an STS contribution. Original research, discussion papers, short research notes and review essays are listed; existing literature or documents can support suitable studies. Research articles are normally limited to 12,000 words. Preprints are accepted; do not update the preprint during review and link the published version afterward. It is not a prediction for a particular manuscript or a comparison with citation impact in other disciplines.

name: Research Ethics
scope_notes: Research ethics, scientific integrity, research regulation and ethics-review processes. Theoretical original articles and critical reviews allow work based on existing evidence; new clinical studies are unnecessary. Original empirical articles normally have a 7,000-word limit, theoretical articles 5,000, and reviews 3,000–6,000. Letters receive editorial review and are not automatically peer-reviewed research articles. An AI statement is mandatory in every submission, including an explicit statement of no AI use where applicable. Preprints are accepted but must not be updated during review; accepted work requires a final-publication link. The journal-specific AI statement requirement is stricter than Sage's general assistive-editing disclosure exemption.

scope_notes: Cross-disciplinary development and evaluation of evidence-synthesis methods: statistical methodology, simulations, search and extraction, bias assessment, qualitative synthesis, graphics and software.
